edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC6 A criteria value written as a constant, a person identifier in a log, or a criterion authored here is refused by the build (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a component writes a criteria value as a constant, a log or workflow input carries a person name, address, contact value or identity number, or this service authors or approves a criterion
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the build fails and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC7 A call without a valid identity, without the declared right or to an unknown route is answered 401, 403 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller is not authenticated, or the role does not hold the declared right, or the route is not a provided operation
    When the operation is called
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 with the platform error envelope and nothing is read or written

  Scenario: AC8 A replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key answers the first outcome and writes nothing new (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write for case "RC-2026-000914" was accepted under an Idempotency-Key
    When the same Idempotency-Key is sent again
    Then one record, one pin and one answer exist for the case and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC9 A retried or timed-out activity pins nothing until one answer is accepted (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-decision package read does not answer inside its budget on an attempt
    When the workflow retries the activity on its own schedule
    Then nothing is pinned or written before one answer is accepted, and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope when the retries end without an answer
